summary: Backend regression + feature tests for simplified Price List feature. Updated existing /api/pricelist public test to match new spec (keys 'categories', 'products', 'total_products' are REMOVED — only {images: [...]} now). Added 4 new tests: order preservation, Mongo settings-collection persistence, and 6 regression tests confirming untouched endpoints (/products, /products/categories, /privacy, /admin/products auth, /orders/me auth, /health). All 25 tests in test_avr_pricelist_and_cancel.py PASS. Full suite 158/159 (1 unrelated pre-existing failure in test_avr_backend.py::test_cart_flow — hardcoded subtotal 1247.0 vs actual 680.0, carried over from iteration 12). Price List feature works exactly as spec: GET /api/pricelist public → {images}, admin GET + PUT auth-gated (401 unauth, 403 non-admin), PUT enforces de-dupe + 5-cap + empty-filter + order-preservation + persists under settings.key='pricelist'.
action_items: No action required for Price List feature — backend is correct and fully covered.

Pre-existing (carried over from iteration 12): test_avr_backend.py::test_cart_flow has a hardcoded expected subtotal of 1247.0 that no longer matches current seeded product prices (actual 680.0). Update that fixture when convenient — unrelated to this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: _clean_pricelist_images (server.py:1363) correctly dedupes, filters empties, caps at 5 and preserves order — same shape as _normalize_images for products, good consistency.
GET /api/pricelist double-sanitizes with _clean_pricelist_images on read even though PUT already sanitizes on write — safe defensive layer; also protects against DB tampering.

server.py file is now 1579 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold. Consider splitting into routers (auth.py, products.py, orders.py, admin.py, pricelist.py) for maintainability, though not blocking.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_avr_pricelist_and_cancel.py (rewrote TestPricelistPublic to match new shape; added test_admin_put_preserves_order, test_pricelist_persists_in_settings_collection, and TestRegressionNoImpact class with 6 tests)

success_rate.backend: 100% on feature (25/25 pricelist+cancel + 6 regression); 158/159 full suite — 1 unrelated pre-existing failure

seed_data_creation: Tests seed TEST_-prefixed users+sessions directly in Mongo via conftest fixtures and clean up in finally blocks. Pricelist settings are snapshotted before each mutating test and restored afterwards — no persistent state changes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Price List is simplified: /api/pricelist returns ONLY {images: []}. Any attempt to re-introduce `categories`/`products`/`total_products` into this response will be caught by TestPricelistPublic::test_public_pricelist_no_auth. Admin writes via PUT /api/admin/pricelist/images with body {images:[url,...]} — handler calls _clean_pricelist_images (server.py:1363) which dedupes/trims/caps-at-5/preserves-order. Images are stored at settings.key='pricelist' (field name='images'). All 25 feature tests + 6 regression tests pass against the public preview URL.
rca_of_issue: No new bug this iteration. Previously-existing failing test (test_cart_flow) has hardcoded product-price assertions that have drifted from the live seed data; it is unrelated to the Price List work.
